answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay stops a sybil flood. A newcomer joins only when an agent stakes 10 POA, slashed if the newcomer cheats. Like a quill signature, each sponsorship is public, so one sponsor backing a grove of fakes is easy to spot. Idle identities lose 0.2 POA each epoch. Creating 1000 fakes needs 10000 POA locked, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA stake, refunded for good behavior. A walnut grower using one honest agent keeps full rewards, undiluted.
